description: D-01 Exa verification pilot — 5 vehicles × 3 fields
quality_notes: First-run pattern worked. Exa returned useful data for 100% of pairs. MSRP data was most volatile (kept all at Low). The subagent correctly caught the RWD/AWD mixup on IONIQ 5 DC.
improvements_for_next_run: Remind subagent to convert miles↔km explicitly (a later run had one stray mi/km misread)
Emphasize that value corrections in DISAGREES cases should include a proposed_value in the JSON
Model Y Juniper and other emergent-spec vehicles need an escape hatch: 'return current Low unchanged' instead of forcing a guess
